conditions.evidence: The Cancer Genome Atlas Thyroid Cancer (TCGA-THCA) data collection
conditions.label: Thyroid Cancer

modalities.evidence: Clinical, genetic, and pathological data resides in the Genomic Data Commons (GDC) Data Portal

output.population: Subjects from The Cancer Genome Atlas whose tissues were collected from many sites all over the world; images mostly acquired as part of routine care.
output.summary: Radiological images of thyroid cancer patients, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data held in the Genomic Data Commons, enabling genotype-phenotype-outcome studies.
